_readme: Weekly notes index. One object per Xiaohongshu note. Fill `url` with the note's share link (https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/<id>). `date` is YYYY-MM-DD or null. `chars` is the 全文字数 shown on the cover. Series: internship | jobsearch | essay | interview.

entries.title: 阿里淘天一面
entries.summary: First-round interview with Alibaba Taotian's business-technology and supply-chain team: what was asked, how I answered, and what I would prepare differently.

entries.title: 来纽约这一年零十天：跑完第一圈以后
entries.summary: One year and ten days in New York. Re-reading the log I have kept since 16 August 2025 — near-daily at first, then once or twice a week — and what the first lap changed.

entries.title: 无名，无题
entries.summary: Typed by hand at 9:11 on a Monday in Bobst Library, after OAs at Baidu, Alibaba and a US startup: what a job-search season feels like to a CS student who loves AI.

entries.title: 27届 ai 秋招 day4
entries.summary: Day 4 of building an AI-assisted job-search stack: what the pipeline produced, what broke, and what I changed.

entries.title: 27届秋招ai全栈 day3
entries.summary: Day 3: wiring the pieces together — job discovery, answer policy, résumé tailoring — and where a human still has to decide.

entries.title: 8/10 27秋招 day2
entries.summary: Day 2: the dashboard comes up; a rule that the run stops when the state is uncertain and reports back to Codex.

entries.title: 秋招day1 ai全栈从头开始
entries.summary: Day 1 of the 2027 cycle: starting the AI-assisted job-search stack from scratch, and what it should and should not automate.

entries.title: 北美暑期实习最后一周（秋招最后还是要来了）
entries.summary: The last week of the summer internship: what shipped, what did not, and the job-search season arriving whether I am ready or not.

entries.title: 北美实习第6-7周
entries.summary: Weeks 6–7, work edition: finding a direction between forecasting and agents. Why consultancies can make predictions companies cannot (they have a method), and what a more precise, recordable, reproducible version of that looks like.

entries.title: 北美实习第5周：agent还在骑马来的路上
entries.summary: Week 5, 21 June: Dragon Boat Festival and Juneteenth on the same day; the agent is still riding in on horseback; a long weekend drive to Best Buy and the outlets.

entries.title: 实习第 4 周 | AI 不是魔法，数据才是现实
entries.summary: Week 4: AI is not magic, data is the reality. A week where the data work outweighed the model work, and what that taught me about where the effort actually goes.

entries.title: 北美实习周记 · 第三周
entries.summary: Week 3, written on a Sunday night after a week of doom-scrolling and football: the state of the week, and why the days I skip writing are the days worth writing about.

entries.title: 北美实习第二周
entries.summary: Week 2, Friday 12 June, 9 pm. A voice memo that never recorded means the week gets written again from scratch: the AI teammate, Walmart walks and the first real tasks.
